parts.text: In a set of experiments zinc was reacted with sulphuric acid to form hydrogen. The apparatus below was used. gas syringe sulphuric acid 10 20 30 40 50 60 70 80 excess zinc The same mass of zinc was used each time. The volume of acid used was different each time. Use the syringe diagrams to record the volume of hydrogen produced each time in the table.
